rationale: Checksum input is already-normalized ordered records joined by LF without trailing LF; existence is deliberately outside this checksum.

cases.name: empty-existing-or-absent
cases.rationale: Both absent state and an existing empty playlist hash empty bytes; callers track existence separately.

cases.name: single
cases.rationale: No trailing LF participates in the checksum.

cases.name: nfc
cases.rationale: The utility does not normalize; normalized NFC input is hashed literally.

cases.name: nfd
cases.rationale: Unnormalized NFD bytes intentionally differ, proving normalization belongs upstream.
